The guided code of Lab 02, Part 1 (`savings`). The "Your turn" tasks are in the lab.
Data: `data/savings.csv` (from `faraway::savings`).

```{r data}
library(car)
savings <- read.csv("data/savings.csv")
rownames(savings) <- savings$country
fit <- lm(sr ~ pop15 + pop75 + dpi + ddpi, data = savings)
n <- nrow(savings); p <- length(coef(fit))
summary(fit)
confint(fit)
```

## Nested F test

```{r f-test}
fit0 <- lm(sr ~ pop15 + ddpi, data = savings)
anova(fit0, fit)
```

## Residual plots

```{r residuals, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(fit)            # residuals vs fitted, QQ, scale-location, residuals vs leverage
```

## Leverage, studentized residuals, Cook's distance

```{r influence}
h <- hatvalues(fit)
names(h)[h > 2 * p / n]
t_i <- rstudent(fit)
c(max_abs_t = max(abs(t_i)), bonferroni = qt(1 - 0.05 / (2 * n), n - p - 1))
D <- cooks.distance(fit)
round(sort(D, decreasing = TRUE)[1:5], 3)
```

## Collinearity

```{r vif}
vif(fit)
```
